guarantees.claim: The instance u_prim_buf_mul_abx_bayz0 drives mul_ax_byz0_buf and mul_bx_ayz0_buf from the concatenated inputs mul_ax_byz0 and mul_bx_ayz0 through a buffer of width 2*NPower.
The Width parameter is fixed to 2*NPower, exactly matching the total bit-width of the concatenated vector {mul_ax_byz0, mul_bx_ayz0}, preventing width mismatch or unintended truncation/extension.

assumptions.claim: The signals mul_ax_byz0 and mul_bx_ayz0 must be driven to valid logic values (0/1, not X/Z) before their buffered outputs are used downstream.
assumptions.cond: when downstream masked logic samples mul_ax_byz0_buf / mul_bx_ayz0_buf
assumptions.risk: Propagation of X or invalid data into masked AES operations can cause functional failure or potential side-channel leakage.

assumptions.claim: The two input signals mul_ax_byz0 and mul_bx_ayz0 must be independent masked shares (i.e., computed from separate share domains) to preserve the DOM masking order when the buffer isolates them for further multiplication.
assumptions.cond: always, for security under probing attacks
assumptions.risk: If shares are mixed before buffering, a first-order leakage path can reveal secret data, defeating the mask protection.

uncertain_points.claim: The prim_buf instance has no reset input; if the buffer contains state (e.g., a flip-flop) that initializes to X after power-on, the outputs mul_ax_byz0_buf and mul_bx_ayz0_buf may be X, propagating into sensitive masked downstream logic.
uncertain_points.cond: at startup or after a supply ramp with no local reset assertion
uncertain_points.risk: Unknown values entering masked multiplier stages can break functional correctness and create deterministic leakage patterns.

uncertain_points.claim: The primitive buffer prim_buf may be a simple wire (combinational pass-through) and not a registered stage; if so, it provides no temporal isolation or glitch separation, which would violate the DOM scheme’s requirement of buffering intermediate shares.
uncertain_points.cond: when this buffer is used as part of a DOM masked multiplication chain
uncertain_points.risk: Without a true pipeline register, glitches on input aggregates can combine shares at the gate level, leading to first-order leakage of unmasked secret data.
